title: SSC CGL Tier-1 Full Mock Test 02
description: Full Length Mock Test for SSC CGL Tier-1. 100 Questions | 60 Minutes | Reasoning, GA, Quant, English.
instructions: Total 100 questions hain (Reasoning 25, GA 25, Quant 25, English 25).
Wrong answer par 0.5 marks deduct honge.
Test complete hone par result show hoga.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If in a certain code, 'MOTHER' is written as 'NPUIFS', how is 'FATHER' written?
